tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// chos spyod bcu pa cung zad rgyas par spel ba bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang las srid dang rnam grol ba'i// dge legs ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi// zhabs kyi pad+mor phyag 'tshal lo// kun mkhyen thugs rjer ldan pa yis// legs par gsungs pa'i gsung rab la// 'dren pas mchog tu rab bsngags pa'i// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma mchog /sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i tshogs// de nyid las ni byung gyur cing*// de yi sku dang gsung dang thugs// dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bor bzhugs// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams// srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral ba dang*// bla med byang chub thob bya'i phyir// lus can kun dang thabs cig tu// mtshungs med bla ma dam pa dang*// rgyal dang rgyal sras 'phags pa'i tshogs// 'gro ba'i don la rab brtson pa// mkha' mnyam bzhugs la bdag gsol 'debs// phyogs dus kun na bzhugs pa yi// thugs rje cher ldan bla ma dang*// mtshungs pa med pa skyob pa'i mchog /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung ste// ji srid snying po byang chub bar// sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma dang*// dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// phyi nang gsang ba mchod pa'i sprin// mkha' dang mnyam pa du ma yis// bsod nams zhing rab mchog gyur pa// de dag kun la kun nas mchod// srid pa'i rgya mtshor lhung gyur zhing*// nyon mongs chu srin dbang gyur pas// lus ngag yid gsum gyis bsags pa'i// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// bla ma mchog dang sangs rgyas dang*// de sras thugs rje ldan rnams dang*// 'phags pa'i tshogs dang 'gro ba yi// dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// bsod nams dman pas rtogs dka'i phyir// chos gsung bar ni mi bzhed pa'i// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol// 'dod la sred pa'i sems can rnams// srid la skyo ba bskyed bya'i phyir// zhi bar gshegs par dgongs rnams la// mya ngan mi 'da' bdag gsol 'debs// rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa ltar// 'gro ba'i don phyir bdag gis kyang*// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// rgyal sras khru mchog rlabs chen gyis// ji ltar byang chub spyod pa la// rim pa bzhin du bslabs pa ltar// de yi spyod pa'ang bdag gis spyad// dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan// ma lus gcig tu bsdoms byas nas// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog

/gnas skabs tshe rabs 'di nyid du// mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi ba dang*// tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs// yid la 'dod pa 'grub gyur cig /de ltar tshogs gnyis myur sdud pa'i// tshigs su bcad par bsdus pa 'di// dus gsum kun du brjod byas na// bsod nams phung po dpag med 'byung*// dpal ldan bla ma chos kyi rje thugs brtse ba chen po dang ldan pas mdzad pa'i chos spyod yan lag bcu pa zhes bya ba las/ de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa'i dge tshul blo gros kyi ming dang ldan pas cung zad rgyas par spel ba la nyes pa yod na bzod par mdzod/ dge ba yod na mnyes par mdzod// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
